overall_reason: The FAQ accordion opens in 200 ms with a turning chevron, a proper feedback motion (its height shove is the sweep's MOT-003), and the install tabs change instantly, but every transition is Tailwind's default curve and the screenshot gallery empties its large preview for at least 350 ms when a thumbnail is clicked.

score.reason: T-PURPOSE and T-FREQUENCY pass for the accordion and tabs, T-ENTER-EXIT finds a blank preview after a thumbnail click, and T-MOTION-SYSTEM finds framework defaults on all 75 elements.

findings.title: Exits are quicker than entrances and leave no gap
findings.where: screenshot gallery, thumbnail button t3 (preview box 1214 x 683 px, 64% of the viewport), 1440
findings.evidence: On contact-sheet row t3 the old screenshot fades out by about 150 ms and the preview stays an empty dark panel at 250, 400 and 600 ms; the reduced-motion row shows the same gap. The measured transition ends at 270 ms, so the new image has not appeared when the motion ends.
findings.before: The big preview goes blank for at least 350 ms after a thumbnail click.
findings.after: Keep the old screenshot until the new one has loaded, then cross-fade in about 150 ms, or preload the gallery images.
findings.why: Visitors stepping through screenshots see an empty frame on each click, which reads as broken.

findings.title: One curve family and one duration scale
findings.evidence: All 75 transitioning elements use Tailwind's default cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), 70 of them at 150 ms; the accordion's height uses ease-out at 200 ms. The sweep's MOT-001 hits record "transition: all" on 15 elements and transitions on width, height and margin.
findings.after: Set one exit curve and two duration steps as tokens, and open the accordion with a grid-rows or transform technique instead of height.
findings.why: The timing is the framework's, and height animation is what causes the shove the sweep recorded.
findings.root: Tailwind transition utilities and the accordion keyframes

strengths: The FAQ accordion "Can my phone or iPad install KinAI directly?" opens in 200 ms with a 200 ms chevron turn, measured to end at 219 ms, which is quick feedback.
The "Mac Client" install tab switches instantly, which suits a control visitors flip between.
The page runs no load animations and no loops (no running animations at 1440).
not_investigated: the gallery gap may partly come from live image loading; manifest.network records no blocked images
scroll reveals: ROB-001 records 60% of text hidden if IntersectionObserver never fires; not recorded as motion
no 00-contract.md in the run: visitor mode inferred from the screenshots
no passive recording (capture.mjs --passive not run): load motion and loops judged from declared animations only, not from frames
interruptibility and rapid toggles (T-RAPID-TOGGLE): no detector built
scroll-driven and scroll-revealed motion beyond the load: the capture does not scroll while recording
hover as it plays: only the declared transitions are read
route and page transitions: not captured
T-POSTER and T-DEMO-LOOP: no demo animation or looping demo on the page
